claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED observations from retained frame traces; arithmetic fit only
step: ROADMAP S2 (host-side clock reference measurement supporting S2b)
question: Do the phone's dark hour-transition frames place its 70-second hour grid at the measured night-go anchor fire?
verdict: full-06 has five retained transitions on a 70-second grid: the fitted zero is first night frame +3836.7 ms, +0.7 ms from the anchor fire at +3836.0 ms. full-04 has one transition before death: its fitted zero is +3831.4 ms, -48.2 ms from the anchor fire at +3879.6 ms. The full-06 trace supports the phase and interval measurements; full-04's single transition is a weak phase cross-check and says nothing about rate.

method.rule: For each k=1..6, take the first frame within 8 s of releaseAfterFirstFrameMs + 70000*k whose grid_mean_luma is below 20 after a frame at least 30; fit t = zero + 70000*k by mean phase.
method.gate: tools/recompile/test-hour-grid-fit.mjs recomputes transition arithmetic, residuals, intervals, anchor phase, evidence IDs and the committed record hashes without requiring ignored traces.
limits: full-06 has five transitions and four measured intervals; full-04 has one transition only.
The raw frame traces remain on the acquisition machine under artifacts/; committed records retain trace hashes and the extracted luma/time observations.
This record measures the displayed hour-grid timing. It does not establish that encounter rolls use the same accumulator.

next: Test the joint measured reference correction in the host replay; this observation alone does not identify why encounters differ.
